name: Native Foods
notes: 3 photos, all legible printed menu pages, but the same items sometimes appear with two different printed prices across photos (e.g. Orange Cauliflower, Buddha Bowl, sides/desserts), suggesting an older and a reprinted/updated menu were both photographed. Preferred the 'Guest Favorites' branded page (2.jpg) for entrees/sandwiches/burgers, and the updated sides/desserts page with the 'NEW' tag (3.jpg) for sides and sweet treats; unique items only on 1.jpg (Nachos, Elote Dip, Chicken Tenders, Rainbow Salad) were merged in.
